تفتضخين (form VIII)
# تَفْتَضِخِينَ (taftaḍiḵīna) /taf.ta.dˤi.xiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# تُفْتَضَخِينَ (tuftaḍaḵīna) /tuf.ta.dˤa.xiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
